            Published Date: 25th November 2026 
 
Owner: MyGov 
 
 
Associate/Senior Associate  
 
MyGov is the citizen engagement platform of the Government of India. It is an Independent Business 
Division under Digital India Corporation, a Section 8 company under the Ministry of Electronics &  
Information Technology. Details about MyGov can be seen at https://MyGov.in. 
  MyGov is looking for Associate/Senior Associate who is good with communication skills and                                                                          
content writing & curation. 
 
An ideal candidate should have work experience in building and maintaining strong relationships with 
communities, ministries, and key stakeholders, while developing impactful communication materials. 
 
You will be under probation for the first 3 months from the date of joining. It is not mandatory for  
MyGov to absorb you or offer you a regular contract after the completion of the probation period.  
The period of probation can be reduced or increased by MyGov and shall be solely based upon your 
performance. 
 
After successful completion of the initial contract period, a regular contract will be given. 
 
Please review the positions listed below and apply in the form given in this notification. MyGov is 
hiring experienced professionals for an Associate/Senior Associate. 
 
Interested candidates may apply in this form : https://forms.gle/t2nAy6WsSFiSt2TD9
 
            Published Date: 25th November 2026 
 
Owner: MyGov 
 
 
Position: Associate/Senior Associate 
 
No. of Position(s): 1 
 
Qualification: Min. Master’s degree in any discipline 
 
  Experience: 3 - 5 years 
 
  Roles & Responsibilities: 
● Build and maintain strategic relationships with ministries, organizations, state instances, 
autonomous bodies, and communities. 
● Act as the central point of contact to ensure seamless communication and collaboration 
between MyGov and external stakeholders. 
● Design and draft detailed proposals for activities, campaigns, and partnerships on the MyGov 
platform. 
● Create and implement outreach strategies to connect with target audiences, including 
communities, influencers, and ministries. 
● Plan, organize, and execute MyGov events (workshops, conferences, community gatherings). 
● Develop engaging content (written, visual, and presentations) to promote MyGov’s initiatives 
across digital platforms and events. 
● Enhance citizen engagement by managing campaigns on MyGov platforms and coordinating 
with assigned MyGov State Instances. 
● Handle website backend operations to upload and manage campaign activities. 
● Maintain and update data repositories, trackers, and management information systems for all 
partnership and outreach activities. 
● Provide detailed reports (e.g., quarterly reports, quiz summaries) on activities and their 
outcomes. 
● Support the team with data refinement, troubleshooting, and event follow-ups. 
● Design activity calendars in collaboration with the team for key campaigns and events. 
● Independently manage shoot arrangements, liaising with anchors, camera teams, and content 
editors. 
● Strategically use social media and digital platforms to maximize outreach and engagement. 
● Stay informed about government initiatives and community efforts to align them with MyGov’s 
campaigns. 
● Be open to working during late hours and weekends during events or critical campaigns. 
Requirements: 
 
● Technical Skills: Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word), social media management, 
and data systems. Familiarity with camera setups and shooting processes is a plus. 
● Communication: Excellent verbal and written skills with experience in drafting proposals, 
reports, and content for diverse audiences. 
● Organizational Skills: Strong project management abilities with attention to detail and the 
capacity to handle multiple tasks efficiently. 
● Work Location: Delhi

Experience: 10–14 years

Location: New Delhi (on-site)  
About the Role 
SIDH handles Aadhaar-linked identity, financial disbursements, learner PII, and certification data across national 
schemes. As of January 2026, it has zero CISO coverage, no GRC framework, and several procured security tools 
(Varonis, Cymulate, OPSWAT) that are not yet deployed. This is one of the most urgent hires in the PMU. 
 
Educational Qualification 
One of the following (Must have): 
• B.Tech./B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or related engineering 
discipline, OR 
• M.Tech./M.S. in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Applied Cryptography, or related field 
At least one of the following certifications required at deployment (Must have): 
• CISSP, CISM, CEH, OSCP, GWAPT, CSSLP, or CompTIA Security+ 
ISO 27001 Lead Auditor and privacy certifications (DCPP, DPO training) additionally desirable. 
 
Key Responsibilities 
• Establish the platform security governance framework, cyber risk register, policy baseline, and security 
architecture review process 
• Own privacy and compliance leadership for DPDP Act controls — acting as the Data Protection Officer-
equivalent function 
• Lead rollout governance for procured-but-undeployed tools: Varonis (DSPM), Cymulate (BAS), and 
OPSWAT (DAP/CIP) 
• Govern VAPT, application security testing, vulnerability management, and remediation tracking across all 
vendors 
• Drive zero-trust, access control, data classification, and secure third-party access frameworks 
• Coordinate with CERT-In, auditors, ministries, and vendors on incidents, compliance, and assurance 
• Define security architecture sign-off requirements for integrations, APIs, identity flows, cloud controls, and 
new services 
• Activate WAF from monitoring-only to enforcement mode; drive closure of all AS-IS security gaps 
 
 
 
What We Are Looking For 
• Strong experience in security architecture, governance, risk, and compliance for environments handling 
sensitive PII at scale — payments, health data, or govtech 
• This is NOT a policy-only role — must have hands-on security architecture experience 
• Knowledge of DPDP Act obligations (Rules notified January 2025), CERT-In guidelines, and zero-trust 
principles 
• Ability to lead governance without needing to be the SOC operator or penetration tester 
Good to Have 
• Prior experience in public-sector or regulated programmes with Aadhaar, financial, or national-scale PII 
exposure

1. Program Manager: (AI) 
 
Role Summary 
The Program Manager (AI) will run delivery across a portfolio of AI projects for government departments, covering 
in-house teams and empanelled  agencies, plans and dependencies, contracts and payments, approvals, and 
governance reporting. The role requires the discipline to keep a large portfolio on track, firm control of vendors 
against evidence, and the clarity to turn status into decisions. Th e role leads the Product Managers and Business 
Analysts. 
Educational Qualification 
• B.Tech./B.E. or an equivalent technical degree (Must have) 
• MBA or a master’s degree is desirable 
• Certifications (desirable, not mandatory): PMP, PgMP or SAFe ; demonstrated delivery, as listed under 
Minimum Evidence at Screening, shall carry greater weight 
• Candidates from non-traditional backgrounds with a strong verifiable delivery record will be considered  
in lieu of formal qualification 
 
Experience 
 
• 10+ years in technology delivery (12+ years preferred); minimum 3 years managing AI, data or platform 
programme delivery 
• Demonstrable delivery of at least one multi -team technology programme with external vendors , with 
documented scope, budget and outcomes 
• Experience with milestone-based contracts, acceptance and payment against evidence 
• Experience with governance reporting to senior leadership, boards or steering committees 
• Experience leading product managers, business analysts or programme staff 
• Government experience is not required 
 
Key Responsibilities 
 
Integrated Portfolio Planning 
• Maintain one integrated plan across the portfolio, covering milestones, dependencies, the critical path 
and capacity 
Vendor & Contract Management 
• Track agency milestones and service levels, coordinate acceptance with technical leads and the QA Lead, 
release payments against evidence, and manage change requests 
Governance & Reporting 
• Prepare monthly reports for steering and oversight committees, prepare fund-utilisation reports with the 
finance team, and maintain audit-ready records 
Approvals, Data Access & Dependencies 
• Track and unblock departmental approvals, data -sharing agreements, compute allocations and security 
clearances, and escalate with a clear ask 
Portfolio Metrics 
• Track use cases live, adoption, quality, cost and spend against plan, and flag variances early 
 
PMO Operations 
• Run weekly reviews, decision logs and the register of risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies, with 
common templates and cadence across teams 
Team Leadership 
• Lead and develop the Product Managers and Business Analysts 
Technical Competencies 
• Programme Management: integrated planning, critical path, earned value; Jira (Advanced Roadmaps), MS 
Project or Smartsheet 
• Commercial & Financial: milestone-based contracts, service levels, change control, budget tracking and 
forecasting 
• Delivery Methods: Agile, Scrum and SAFe at portfolio level; hybrid delivery with fixed-scope vendors 
• Technical Fluency: the AI and software delivery lifecycle, evaluation and release gates; enough depth to 
challenge estimates and spot risk 
• Analytics & Reporting: advanced Excel or Google Sheets; Power BI or Superset 
• Communication: concise status reports and steering papers; meetings that end in decisions 
 
 
 
 
2. QA Engineer (AI) 
 
Experience:5+ Years 
Location: Delhi 
 
Role Overview 
The QA Engineer – AI will lead the quality assurance function, ensuring the reliability, performance and accuracy 
of software applications and AI-powered solutions. The candidate will manage QA teams, define testing strategies 
and drive automation and AI testing initiatives. 
 
Key Responsibilities 
• Lead and mentor QA engineers and oversee end-to-end testing activities. 
• Develop test strategies, test plans and automation frameworks. 
• Manage functional, integration, regression, API and performance testing. 
• Perform testing of AI/ML-based applications, Generative AI and LLM-powered solutions. 
• Validate AI-generated responses for accuracy, relevance and consistency. 
• Identify AI hallucinations, bias, incorrect outputs and prompt-related issues. 
• Perform testing of AI chatbots, RAG-based applications and conversational AI solutions. 
• Drive test automation and AI-based testing initiatives. 
• Coordinate with development, DevOps and AI/ML teams. 
• Monitor defect resolution, quality metrics and release readiness. 
 
Required Skills & Experience 
• 5+ years of experience in QA and Software Testing 
• Hands-on experience in AI/ML and Generative AI application testing is mandatory. 
• Experience in LLM testing, prompt testing and AI response validation. 
• Knowledge of hallucination detection and RAG testing. 
• Strong experience in Selenium, Cypress, Playwright or equivalent automation tools. 
• Experience with API testing tools such as Postman and Rest Assured. 
• Familiarity with JIRA, TestRail and Agile methodologies. 
• Strong leadership, analytical and stakeholder management skills. 
Education 
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field. 
• Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML or a related discipline will be an added advantage. 
• Relevant certifications in Software Testing, Test Automation, AI/ML or Generative AI will be preferred 
 
Preferred 
Experience in testing AI -powered enterprise applications, LLM -based platforms, AI chatbots and automated AI 
evaluation frameworks. 
 
 
 
 
3. Job Title: DevOps Engineer – AI/ML 
Experience: 5–7 Years 
Job Summary 
The National e-Governance Division (NeGD) is seeking an experienced DevOps Engineer with strong expertise in 
infrastructure automation, cloud technologies, CI/CD pipelines, containerization and deployment management. 
The ideal candidate should also possess hands -on experience in supporting AI/ML -based applications, AI model 
deployment, MLOps practices and automation of AI-driven solutions. 
The role will involve managing scalable and secure infrastructure, streamlining application deployments, and 
enabling reliable delivery of conventional as well as AI -powered applications supporting various e -governance 
initiatives under the Digital India programme. 
Key Responsibilities 
1. Infrastructure Automation 
• Develop, implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate build, testing and deployment processes. 
• Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Ansible or CloudFormation. 
• Automate system configurations and application deployments. 
• Demonstrate proficiency in advanced Linux/Unix commands and system administration. 
2. Platform and Release Management 
• Set up and deploy Python, Java and Node.js-based microservices. 
• Configure and manage cron jobs and automation scripts. 
• Configure NGINX web servers for static website deployment and load balancing. 
• Manage source code repositories and version control platforms such as Git. 
• Perform performance optimisation of microservices and web servers. 
• Manage Docker environments and Kubernetes administration. 
3. AI/ML Infrastructure and Deployment 
• Deploy, configure and manage AI/ML-based applications and services. 
• Support deployment and operationalisation of machine learning models in production environments. 
• Work with MLOps tools and practices for model deployment, monitoring and lifecycle management. 
• Build and maintain automated pipelines for AI/ML model training, testing and deployment. 
• Support integration and deployment of AI-enabled applications, including LLM-based solutions. 
• Monitor performance, scalability and availability of AI/ML workloads. 
• Collaborate with AI/ML engineers and development teams to streamline model deployment and production 
operations. 
• Experience with GPU-based infrastructure and AI workload optimisation will be an added advantage. 
4. Cloud and On-Premises Infrastructure Management 
• Manage and optimise cloud environments such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud. 
• Manage and maintain on-premises data centre environments. 
• Ensure scalability, high availability, disaster recovery and cost optimisation. 
• Support infrastructure requirements for AI/ML workloads. 
5. System Monitoring and Maintenance 
• Implement monitoring, logging and alerting solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack or Nagios. 
• Proactively identify and resolve infrastructure and application-related issues. 
• Monitor system health, application performance and resource utilisation. 
6. Security and Compliance 
• Implement security best practices and ensure compliance with applicable government regulations and data 
protection policies. 
• Manage access controls, authentication and authorisation mechanisms. 
• Ensure secure deployment and management of applications and infrastructure. 
7. Collaboration and Continuous Improvement 
• Work closely with development, QA, DevOps and AI/ML teams. 
 
• Participate in code reviews and provide infrastructure and deployment recommendations. 
• Identify opportunities for automation and process improvement. 
• Stay updated with emerging DevOps, cloud computing and AI/ML technologies. 
8. Documentation 
• Maintain documentation for deployment processes, infrastructure configurations and system architecture. 
• Develop operational runbooks and technical guides. 
Qualifications and Experience 
Education 
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field. 
• Master's degree or relevant technical certifications will be an added advantage. 
Experience 
• Minimum 5–7 years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, System Administration or related roles. 
• Proven experience in CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD or CircleCI. 
• Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes and container orchestration. 
• Experience managing cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud. 
• Strong experience in Linux/Unix system administration and scripting. 
• Hands-on experience working with AI/ML-based applications, AI model deployment or MLOps practices 
is required. 
• Experience in automating deployment pipelines for AI/ML workloads. 
• Understanding of production environments for AI-enabled applications and services. 
Skills and Competencies 
Technical Expertise 
• Proficiency in Bash, Python or Ruby scripting. 
• Strong understanding of networking concepts, security protocols and system architecture. 
• Experience with Terraform, Ansible, Puppet or Chef. 
• Knowledge of monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana and ELK Stack. 
• Understanding of MLOps concepts, AI/ML deployment workflows and model monitoring. 
• Familiarity with cloud-based AI/ML services and LLM application deployment. 
• Knowledge of GPU infrastructure and AI workload management will be an advantage. 
Problem-Solving 
• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. 
• Ability to diagnose and resolve complex infrastructure, deployment and application issues. 
Communication and Collaboration 
• Strong communication skills and ability to work with cross-functional teams. 
• Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. 
Understanding of E-Governance 
• Familiarity with the Digital India initiative and e-governance frameworks. 
• Awareness of government IT policies, standards and regulatory requirements. 
Preferred Certifications 
• AWS Certified DevOps Engineer. 
• Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA). 
• Docker or other relevant containerisation certifications. 
• Relevant cloud, AI/ML or MLOps certifications. 
 
 
 
4. Full Stack Developer (AI/ML & Web Applications) 
 
Role Summary 
The Full Stack Developer will design, build and deploy secure, scalable web applications with integrated AI and 
machine learning capabilities. The role requires strong full -stack engineering across frontend, backend, data and 
cloud layers, together with practical AI/ML engineering competence: integrating models across commercial, cloud 
and self-hosted providers, building retrieval and agent workflows, and adapting and serving models where required. 
Educational Qualification 
• B.Tech./B.E., M.Tech., MCA or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Information Technology, AI/ML or a related 
discipline (Must have) 
• Certifications are not mandatory; demonstrated work, as listed under Minimum Evidence at Screening, shall 
carry greater weight 
• Candidates with strong verifiable work (production applications or significant open -source contributions) 
will be considered in lieu of formal qualification 
Experience 
• 4+ years of professional full -stack development (5+ years preferred); minimum 2 years building and 
deploying AI- or ML-powered features in production applications 
• Demonstrable end-to-end ownership of at least one production web application, covering frontend, backend, 
database, deployment and monitoring 
• Demonstrable experience delivering at least one LLM or ML-powered application to end users (such 
as a retrieval-augmented assistant, a document-processing workflow or an agent), including its evaluation 
and monitoring 
• Hands-on experience with Python and TypeScript in production, and with React-based frontends 
• Experience deploying containerised applications on cloud platforms through CI/CD pipelines 
• Experience fine-tuning or self-hosting models, working in regulated sectors, or building Indian -language 
applications is a plus 
Key Responsibilities 
Application Development 
• Design and develop responsive, accessible web applications using React and Next.js with TypeScript 
• Develop backend services and APIs in Python (FastAPI ) and Node.js, with clear contracts (OpenAPI or 
GraphQL) and versioning 
• Design data models and optimise queries across relational and NoSQL databases, and implement caching 
and background job processing 
• Translate functional requirements into well-structured, maintainable and production-ready code 
AI & LLM Integration 
• Integrate LLMs in a provider-agnostic manner across commercial APIs, cloud AI platforms and self-hosted 
open-weight models, through an abstraction or gateway layer, so that models can be switched or compared 
without application changes 
• Build LLM -powered features, including streaming conversational interfaces, retrieval -augmented 
generation with source citations, structured extraction and tool -calling agents using the Model Context 
Protocol (MCP) 
• Implement retrieval pipelines covering document ingestion and parsing, chunking, embeddings, hybrid 
vector search and re-ranking 
• Implement routing, caching, rate limiting and fallbacks across providers to control quality, cost and latency 
Model Integration & Serving 
• Integrate and serve pre -trained models (such as OCR, speech, classification and embedding models, 
including Indic language models) behind production APIs 
• Fine-tune or adapt models where required (for example, LoRA  fine-tuning of an LLM or embedding 
model), in coordination with data scientists 
 
• Build evaluation suites for AI features (golden datasets, regression tests and LLM -based evaluation) and 
run them in CI as release gates 
Security, Privacy & Responsible AI 
• Implement authentication and authorisation (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and role -based access control), 
and secure handling of APIs, secrets and personal data 
• Apply OWASP Top 10 and OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications controls, including defences against 
prompt injection and data leakage 
• Apply data-minimisation practices in compliance with applicable data protection law, including for data 
sent to external model providers, and design human review for consequential AI outputs 
Quality, Deployment & Operations 
• Practise test -driven development with unit, integration and end -to-end tests, and maintain adequate 
coverage 
• Containerise applications and manage deployments through CI/CD pipelines on Kubernetes or serverless 
platforms, using infrastructure as code 
• Instrument applications with logging, metrics and tracing, including LLM traces, token usage and cost, and 
participate in incident resolution 
• Ensure accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.2 and GIGW) and support for Indian languages in user interfaces 
Collaboration & Mentoring 
• Participate in Agile delivery, code reviews and architecture discussions 
• Mentor junior developers, and document designs, APIs and operational runbooks 
Technical Competencies 
• Frontend: TypeScript, React, Next.js (App Router and server components), Tailwind CSS, component 
libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent), TanStack Query; accessibility and internationalisation 
• Backend: Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, asyncio) and Node.js (NestJS, Fastify or Express); REST with 
OpenAPI, GraphQL; WebSockets and server -sent events for streaming; background jobs (Celery or 
BullMQ) 
• Databases & Caching: PostgreSQL (with pgvector), MongoDB, Redis; ORMs (SQLAlchemy, Prisma or 
Drizzle); schema migrations and query optimisation 
• LLM Providers & Frameworks:  commercial APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini), cloud AI 
platforms (Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI), Indian providers (Sarvam, Bhashini) and 
self-hosted open-weight models via vLLM or Ollama; gateways such as LiteLLM; LangGraph, LlamaIndex 
or equivalent multi-provider frameworks; structured outputs, tool calling and MCP 
• Retrieval & Vector Search:  embeddings, chunking strategies, hybrid search and re -ranking; vector 
databases (pgvector, Qdrant, Milvus or Weaviate); document parsing (Docling or vision -language OCR 
models) 
• Applied ML: PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers for inference and fine-tuning (PEFT); scikit-learn; 
ONNX Runtime and quantised models; pre -trained models for OCR, speech (IndicConformer, Whisper) 
and Indic NLP (AI4Bharat) 
• AI Evaluation & Observability:  promptfoo, DeepEval or RAGAS in CI; MLflow; Langfuse  or Arize 
Phoenix; OpenTelemetry, Prometheus and Grafana 
• Security: OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, Keycloak or equivalent identity providers; OWASP Top 10 
and OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications; secrets management; guardrails for LLM inputs and outputs 
• Testing, DevOps & Cloud: pytest, Vitest or Jest, Playwright; Git, GitHub Actions or GitLab CI, Docker, 
Kubernetes and Helm, Terraform; AWS, Azure or GCP managed services 
• Data Pipelines (desirable): Airflow or Dagster; Kafka or other message queues 
 
 
 
General Conditions applicable to all applicants covered under this advertisement 
1. Those candidates, who are already in regular or contractual employment under Central / State 
Government, Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Bodies, are expected to apply 
through proper channel or attach a ‘No Objection Certificate’ from the employer concerned 
with the application OR produce No Objection Certificate at the time of interview. 
2. NeGD reserves the right to fill all or some or none of the positions advertised without 
assigning any reason as it deems fit.  
3. The positions are purely temporary in nature for the project of NeGD/DIC and the appointees 
shall not derive any right or claim for permanent appointment at NeGD/DIC or on any 
vacancies existing or that shall be advertised for recruitment by NeGD in future.  
4. NeGD reserves the right to terminate the appointments of all positions with a notice of one 
month or without any notice by paying one month’s salary in lieu of the notice period. 
5. The designation of the selected candidates shall be mapped as per the existing designation 
policy of NeGD. 
6. In case of a query, the following officer may be contacted:

iii. Aspirants possessing relevant qualification along with registration as on the date of interview will only 
be considered; those whose result is awaited will not be considered. 
4. Terms &Conditions: - 
1. Candidate should report in the Administration Office situated at Ground Floor of ESIC Hospital, 
Sonagiri, Bhopal from 9:15 A.M to 11:00 A.M on the stipulated date along with the relevant copies of 
their documents.Candidates reporting after 11.15 A.M. will not be entertained for Walk-In-
Interview. 
2. Reservations for other reserved categories will be executed as per existing Central Government Rules. 
3. Candidates seeking Reservation / Age relaxation benefits under SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PWD/Ex-
serviceman category must ensure that they are entitled to such reservation as per eligibility prescribed 
in the notice and as per the instruction issued by Government of India. They should also be in 
possession of the certificates in the prescribed format of Govt. of India in support of their claim. 
Candidates seeking reservation under EWS category, should submit their EWS certificate as prescribed 
vide Govt. of India, Department of Personnel & Training OM No. 36039/1/2019-Estt. (Res) dated 31-
01-2019. Candidates claiming reservation/age relaxation under OBC category should submit their OBC 
certificate as prescribed vide Govt. of India, Department of Personnel & Training OM No. 
36012/22/93- Estt.(SCT) dated 08/09/1993 which is modified vide OM No. 36033/3/2004 Estt. (Res.) 
dated 09/03/2004, further modified vide OM No. 36033/3/2004 Estt. (Res.) dated 14/10/2008 or the 
latest notification of Government of India. 
4. In case of non-availability of reserved category candidates in the advertised post, the vacancy may be 
filled up for less than 45 Days as de-reserved seats(s). 
5. Private practice of any kind will not be allowed (except for Part Time Specialist) 
6. The number of vacancies/ category-wise vacancies may vary/likely to increase or decrease. 
7. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for appearing in the walk-in-interview. 
8. Application should be submitted for each post separately. 
9. The Medical Superintendent reserves the right to alter the date or cancel the interview. 
10. Full-time Specialist on contractual basis shall be recruited for a period of 3 years with annual 
evaluation and term renewed every year based on satisfactory performance. 
11. Selected candidate has to sign the contract agreement containing terms and conditions, on a Non-
Judicial Stamp Paper of Rs. 500/- before joining. The original contract will be with the hospital and its 
copy will be with candidate. The cost of the Non-Judicial Stamp Paper will be borne by the candidate. 
12. The Contractual specialist shall be responsible for all cases undergoing treatment under his supervision 
in his discipline. 
 
13. Full time Contractual Specialists will be entitled for the leave @ 04 days for each month of work on 
prorate basis in a calendar year. In the event, the specialist prefers not to avail the leave, the same may 
be encashed to a maximum limit of 30 days/ year. 
14. Period of contract for part time contractual specialist will be of 1 year from the date of joining or till 
regular incumbent joins. 
15. Part time contractual specialist will not be entitled for any kind of leave. 
16. The selected Candidate must have a professional indemnity policy which should cover the period as 
desired by ESIC in the bid. The policy is meant to cover professional liability falling on them as a 
result of error and omissions committed by them while rendering professional services. The minimum 
sum assured per annum should be30 lakhs for Anesthesiologist, Rs. 20 lakhs for the General Surgeons, 
ENT, EYE, Orthopedics, OBGY, etc. and10 lakhs for the General Medicine, Dentists, Radiologists, 
Pathologists etc. A copy of the Insurance & Premium and receipt must be submitted within 7 days from 
the date of engagement. 
17. The Contractual Specialist and Senior Residents (to be engaged on Contract) will be required to deposit 
security of Rs. 10000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand only) through Demand Draft in favor of ESI Fund A/c. 
No.1, Bhopal at the time of joining. The same is refundable after completion of contract period and on 
production of “No dues certificate”. 
18. It is advised to candidates to bring original documents & Xerox in support of DOB, Educational 
qualifications, experience, caste certificate, EWS certificate etc. 
19. Candidates applying for senior residents have to give an undertaking regarding Government hospital 
residency compliance. Candidates who have already worked as SR for 03 years after PG 
Degree/Diploma under Central Residency scheme in any Govt. organization are not eligible to apply 
for the post of Senior residents on contract basis under 3-year Senior Residency scheme.     
20. If any stage of recruitment process, it is found that the candidate is not fulfilling any of the eligibility 
condition ESIC reserves the right to reject/ cancel the candidature/selection/ appointment of said 
candidate.      
21. Selected candidates will have no claim for regularization of services in the Hospital/Medical 
Institution. 
22. The appointment is subject to Medical Fitness. 
23. The selected Full Time/Part Time Contractual Specialist will be required to submit acceptance/consent 
letter in writing before appearing for Medical examination. 
24. Preference will be given to Full time Specialist. In case of unavailability of Full time Specialist part 
time specialist of the respective category will be appointed. 
25. Contractual engagement may be terminated /discontinued by the either side giving one-month prior 
notice to this effect without assigning reason. 
Note: - The vacancies have been prepared after all due diligence & care after implementation of Government of 
India reservation roster as per rules. If any discrepancy is noted at later stage, then it may be corrected/ rectified 
at the time of notice. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  
Other Instructions: - 
1. All the interested candidates are requested to appear for the document verification within the schedule 
time (9:15 AM to 11:00 AM). No candidate will be allowed to attend document verification after 11:15 
AM on all schedule date as mentioned above. 
2. Only the candidates whose documents are verified and found eligible for the post of Senior Residents 
&Full time/part time Contractual Specialists will be allowed to attend walk-interview. 
3. The Medical Superintendent, ESIC Hospital, Sonagiri, Bhopal reserves the right to vary these 
vacancies including increase or decrease or cancellation of filling up of any or all post without 
assigning any reason. 
4. Change in date of interview, etc if any, will be intimated on website (www.esic.gov.in) only. 
Candidates are advised to check the website regularly for any update/information relating to the 
recruitment. Other terms and conditions as mentioned above. 
5. The Medical Superintendent, ESIC Hospital, Sonagiri, Bhopal will be the controlling authority for full 
time/part time Contractual Specialist. 
 
INSTRUCTIONS FOR CANDIDATES 
  
Candidates are requested to bring their Original Certificates in evidence of ageproof (Date of Birth) 
educational Qualification, Medical Council Registration of the State/MCI, experience certificates, 
Caste certificate (as applicable)  along with one set of self-attested Xerox copies with 2 passport size 
recent colour photographs for appearing in interview with duly filled in application form in the

No:39/ESICH-Vapi/Med.Br./SR/FTCS/PTCS/(Pt.file)/2021      Date:18.11.2026 
 
 
 
Notification for engagement of contractual Full Time Specialist (FTCS) /Part Time 
Specialist (PTCS) and Senior Resident (SR) 
 
Walk-in-Interview  on  08.12.2026 and if vacant, 2nd (Second) Thursday of every month 
time 10:00 A.M. to 01:00 P.M. 
 
 ESIC Hospital, Vapi, invites eligible candidates for Walk -in-interview on 08.12.2026 and 
if vacant 2nd Thursday of every month (Till 06 months or till vacancy complete) for engagement 
of contractual Full Time Contractual Specialist (FTCS) / Part Time Contractual Specialist 
(PTCS) and Senior Resident (SR) as per the details mentioned at Annexure – A & Annexure A-
1. 
 Interested candidates for above posts and meeting the requirements as per t he criteria 
in detailed advertisement may appear for the WALK -IN-INTERVIEW at ESIC Hospital, Vapi -
Selvasa Road, Chanod, Vapi, District–Valsad,Gujarat-396195 at 10:00 Hours to 13:00 Hours on 
08.12.2026. Registration will be closed at 12:00 PM, 08.12.2026. 
 
 Candidate must fix prior appointment with Dr. Shahed Malek, (Deputy Medical 
Superintendent) Mob: + 9428513678 before appearing for Interview. They can also email on: 
ms-vapi.gj@esic.gov.in. This advertisement will be valid for 06 months from the date of publish. 
 
 
 
MEDICAL SUPERINTENDENT 
ESIC HOSPITAL,VAPI

 All other terms and conditions applicable to the Senior Resident (S.R.) appointed against

General Terms and conditions 
 
1. The number of vacancies may be changed without any prior notice at the time of 
interview as per the actual requirements of the Hospital. 
 
2. No TA/DA will be admissible either for the 'Walk-in-interview" or for joining the post. 
  
3. The Competent Authority reserves the right to fill-up all or not to fill-up any post. 
 
4. Selected candidates / appointment will have no claim or right for regularization of the 
service / preference for regular appointment in the hospital. 
5. The selected candidates will have to join within 07 days from the date of receipt ofthe 
Selection order. 
 
6. The selection is subject to the candidates proving their medical fitness & verification 
of their Character & Antecedents etc. 
 
7. In case regular candidate appointed / joins, the appointment shall be terminated as 
per the condition of the contract. 
 
8. No claim for any service benefit like, PF, Pension, Gratuity, medical Allowance, 
Seniority, Promotion will be admissible. 
9. Candidates must be registered with the Gujarat Medical Council (GMC), Medical 
Council of India (MCI), or any other State Medical Council before joining the post. If a 
candidate does not have Gujarat Medical Council (GMC) registration at the time of joining , 
he/she must obtain GMC registration within one month of appointment. 
 
10. The candidate who is in the Government Service should submit "No Objection 
Certificate" from the employer at the time of interview. 
 
11. Candidate seeking reservation benefits for SC/ST/OB C/EWS must ensure that they 
are entitled to such reservations per eligibility prescribed in the Notice. They should also be 
in possession of the required certificates in the prescribed format in support of their claim as 
stipulated in this Notice. OBC cand idates should ensure that they are in possession of valid 
OBC Certificate issued within the due date issued by the authority mentioned in the format. 
Candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC category should produce valid caste certificate issued 
by the Tehsildar / Revenue Divisional Officer. OBC certificate must be as prescribed vide 
DoPT, Govt of India OM No. 36012/22/93-Estt. (SCT) dated 15.11.1993 which should certify 
that the candidate does not belong to anyone of the Creamy Layers. 
 
12. The position of reservatio n is interchangeable among specialties within each 
category. 
 
13. Canvassing in any form shall be disqualification. 
  
14. The posts are contractual and the contractual engagement may be terminated / 
discontinued by either side giving one -month prior notice to this effect without assigning any 
reason. 
 
15. The selected candidate shall be registered under AEBAS installed by the hospital. 
Employees shall be paid the Remuneration strictly as per biometric attendance marked by 
them. For verification of attendance, Decision of the hospital administration shall be final. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
39/ESICH-Vapi/Med.Br./SR/FTCS/PTCS/(Pt.file)/2021 I/4648569/2026
 
 
16. In case of selection, the candidate has to enter into an agreement with Medical 
Superintendent, ESIC Hospital, Vapi, on Non-judicial stamp paper of Rs. 300/-. Upon joining, 
the selected candidate has to submit a security deposit of Rs. 30,000/ - (Rupeesthirty 
thousand only) as Demand draft in favour of 'ESI Fund Account No.1' payable at State Bank 
of India, GIDC Vapi Branch which is refundable after successfulcompletion of contract and 
production of 'No  dues certificate'. However, this amount will be appropriated towards 
administrative cost in case, the candidate resigns / terminates his/her contract without prior 
one month's notice. 
 
17. The Medical Superintendent reserves the right to fill-up or cancel any vacancy at any 
time. 
 
18. Candidates claiming reservation under EWS category should produce their EWS 
certificate as prescribed vide DoPT, Govt of India OM No. 36039/1/2019 -Estt. (Res) dated 
31.01.2019. 
19. Available on call 24x7 as he/she will be drawing emergency call charges. 
 
20. The Specialist shall be responsible for all cases undergoing treatment under their 
supervision in his discipline. 
 
21. The candidate claiming reservation / age relaxation on grounds of belonging to OBC 
should submit the community Certificate in Annexure "A" prescribe vide Govt. Of India, 
Department of Personnel and Training OM No.36036/2/2013 -Estt (Res). Date 30.05.2014 
failing which the benefit of reservation / relaxation will not be given or their application shall 
be rejected and no request/ correspondence will be entertained. Certificates issued in other 
format will not be accepted and the candidates will be treated as "General Category" for all 
purpose. 
 
22. The candidates are advised to bring duly filled Application Form in prescribed 
proforma (provided with the advertisement on website) and original certificates with one set 
of photocopies of the certificates. 
23. All the can didates are directed to report in the office of the Medical Superintendent 
ESIC Hospital, Vapi, Gujarat as per the timing mentioned. 
 
24. The decision of the selection board will be final on all aspects of selection and no 
further correspondence will be entertained under any circumstance. 
 
25. The appointment for part time specialist will be for one year from the date of joining 
or till appointment of regular incumbents whichever is earlier. The extension of contract will 
be subject to ESIC policy revised from time to time. 
26. Hostel accommodation/quarters/uniform will not be provided. 
 
27. The candidates shall be governed by the relevant Rules and Regulations adopted by 
the E.S.I. Corporation or concerned Government department / ministries in this regard. 
 
28. Other terms & conditions will be applicable as issued by the Competent Authority 
from time to time. 
SPECIAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS APPLICABLE TO FULL TIME SPECIALISTS: 
 
a) Specialist shall be recruited for a period of1 year with annual evaluation and term  
renewed every year based on satisfactory performance 
b) Private practice will not be allowed. 
c) Available on call 24x7.

days.

i) Other T&C would be in line with those issued vide HQ Letter dated 23.01.2018 as in.

b) Minimum working hour will be 16 per week (as already approved) as per directions  
of MS/ Dean. 
c) He/ She will not be entitled for any kind of leave or benefits. 
 
d) Available on call 24x7 as he will be drawing emergency call charges. 
 
e) The specialist shall be responsible for all cases undergoing treatment under his

f) Age of specialist should not exceed 69 years as per memorandum number No U-
13/14/38/2020-Med | (ESIC/SC) Dated: 01.09.2021 
g) The selected specialist must have a professional indemnity policy which should cover 
the period as desired by ESIC in the bid. The policy is meant to cover professional liability 
falling on them as a result  of error and omissions committed by them while rendering 
professional services. The minimum sum assured per annum should be Rs.30 lac for 
Anesthesiologists. Cardiac Surgeon, Neuro Surgeons, Plastic Surgeons etc. (2) rs.20 lakhs 
for General Surgeons, Gynec ologist, Obstetrician etc. (3) for Physicians Dentists, 
Radiologists, Pathologists etc. It should be at least of Rs.10 lacs. A copy of the Insurance & 
Premium and receipt must be submitted within 7 days from the date of engagement. 
 
h) Other T&C would be in line with those issued vide HQ Letter dated 23.01.2018 as in. 
SPECIAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS APPLICABLE TO SENIOR RESIDENT (S.R) 
 
a) Senior Resident shall be recruited for a period of 01 year with annual evaluation and 
term renewed every year based on satisfact ory performance and Private practice will not be 
allowed.

30. Other T&C would be in line with those issued vide HQ Letter dated 13.04.2022

How to Apply 
 
a) The eligible candidates should appear  for a walk-in interview on the appointed 
date & time  along-with their properly filled application in prescribed proforma. They 
should also bring two recent passport size photographs along with one set of attested 
photocopies and originals of testimonials. 
b) Cut-off date for age, qualification etc shall be reckoned as date of interview. 
c) It may please be noted that No TA/DA will be paid for attending the Interview or 
Document Verification. 
 
Documents to be submitted: 
 
1. Two passport size Photographs. 
 
2. . Two sets of the following testimonials alongwith the originals for verification: 
 
3. ProofofDateofBirth 
 
4. SSC/Matriculation Certificate or equivalent

7. Caste certificate/Category Certificate in support of SC/ST/OBC (Non -creamy

servicemen, if applicable. 
 
8 UID (Aadhaar certificate) 
 
9. Experience Certificate 
 
10. Any other documents, if applicable/relevant. 
 
Note: Selected candidates have to report for duty immediately or the date mentioned 
in offer letter, failing which it will be presumed that they are not interested in joining 
and their appointment will be deemed to be considered as cancelled without any 
correspondence in this regard. 
Please Note: Corrigendum/extension etc., if any shall be published only on our 
website: "https://esic.gov.in/recruitments" column. Please visit our website regularly.

The main responsibility of the Ministry is to protect and safeguard the interests of workers in general and those who constitute the poor, deprived and disadvantage sections of the society, in particular, with due regard to creating a healthy work environment for higher production and productivity and to develop and coordinate vocational skill training and employment services. Government’s attention is also focused on promotion of welfare and providing social security to the labour force both in organized and unorganized sectors, in tandem with the process of liberalization. These objectives are sought to be achieved through enactment and implementation of various labour laws, which regulate the terms and conditions of service and employment of workers. The State Governments are also competent to enact legislations, as labour is a subject in the concurrent list under the Constitution of India. Start Your Journey Choose your path — we have tailored tools for everyone For Jobseekers For Employers For Counsellors For Career Centers Find Your Next Opportunity Explore 10 lakh+ job vacancies across sectors, cities, and skill levels — from freshers to experienced professionals. Government & private jobs AI resume + interview coach Login / Register Your Career. India's Future. Connect with 8.5 lakh+ employers. Discover government, private & international jobs. All free, always. Download on the App Store Frequently asked questions Everything you need to know about using NCS. What is NCS? The National Career Service (NCS) is a one-stop solution offering a wide range of employment and career-related services to the citizens of India, including job search, job matching, career content, counselling, and job fair information. It is an initiative of the Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India. Who can register on the portal? Job Seekers, Employers, Skill Providers, Career Counsellors, Local Service Providers, Career Centers, Placement Organisations, Households, and Government Departments. Is NCS free to use? Yes. NCS does not charge any fee at any stage of registration, job application, or interview processing. Jobseekers should not pay fees to employers. Is a mobile app available? Yes. The NCS mobile app is available for finding and applying for jobs. It can be downloaded from the app store links on the portal home page. How can I avoid fake NCS communication? Some websites and individuals falsely claim an association with NCS or use its logo. Please verify information only on the official website, www.ncs.gov.in . You may contact NCS at support.ncs@gov.in or on the toll-free helpline 1514. Cyber fraud can be reported on 1930. Beware of Misleading Communication It has been reported to us that some websites/employers/persons claim to have association with National Career Service (NCS)/Ministry of Labour & Employment (MoLE) are using the logo of NCS. They are fraudulent and tarnishing the image and reputation of NCS. NCS services are free of cost. NCS does not charge any fee at any stage of registration, job application, interview processing and other employment related services. Jobseekers should not pay fees to employers. NCS does not endorse or take responsibility for such practices. Verify information from the official NCS website: www.ncs.gov.in Reach out to us at: support[dot]ncs[at]gov[dot]in 1514 (NCS) 1930 (Cyber Crime) Official Email Addresses: support[dot]ncs[at]gov[dot]in noreply-ncs[at]gov[dot]in no-reply[at]sampark[dot]gov[dot]in Namaste! 👋 Ask me about employment and skill development schemes. Namaste! I am the Employment Generation Schemes Assistant. Web Advertisement        02.11.2026 
Ministry of Electronics, and Information Technology, MeitY , has established India AI Independent 
Business Division (India AI) under Digital India Corporation for implementing the India AI mission. 
The India AI Mission aims to create a robust ecosystem that  accelerates AI innovation through 
strategic initiatives and collaborations spanning both public and private domains. By 
democratizing access to computing resources, enhancing data quality, nurturing homegrown AI 
expertise, attracting top talent, fostering  industry partnerships, supporting startup ventures, 
promoting socially impactful AI projects, and emphasizing ethical practices, the mission seeks to 
foster responsible and inclusive growth within India’s AI landscape. Government of India has 
recently approved the IndiaAI Mission to democratize access to AI innovation pillars and ensure 
global competitiveness of India’s AI ecosystem catalyzing AI innovation through strategic 
programs and partnerships across the public and private sectors. By democratizing computing 
access, improving data quality, developing indigenous AI capabilities, attracting top AI talent, 
enabling industry collaboration, providing startup risk capital, ensuring socially impactful AI 
projects and bolstering ethical AI, it will drive res ponsible, inclusive growth of India’s AI 
ecosystem.  
India AI is currently inviting applications for the below position purely on Contract/ Consolidated 
basis.  
Sr.No Name of the Post No. of Position 
1. Deputy Manager / Manager – 
Administration and Operations 1 
 
The place of posting shall be in New Delhi but transferable to project locations of IndiaAI as 
per existing policy of IndiaAI. 
  
The details can be downloaded from the official website of DIC, NeGD& MeitY, viz. 
www.dic.gov.in, www.negd.gov.in  and www.meity.gov.in 
 
Eligible candidates may apply ONLINE: https://ora.digitalindiacorporation.in/ 
Last date for submission of application: 10/12/2026 
 
  
About India AI 
The IndiaAI Mission aims to build a comprehensive ecosystem that fosters AI innovation by 
democratizing computing access, enhancing data quality, developing indigenous AI 
capabilities, attracting top AI talent, enabling industry collaboration, providing st artup risk 
capital, ensuring socially impactful AI projects, and promoting ethical AI. This mission drives 
responsible and inclusive growth of India's AI ecosystem through seven pillars. 
About DIC 
The Digital India Corporation (formerly Media Lab Asia) has been set up by the Ministry of 
Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India, to innovate, develop 
and deploy ICT and other emerging technologies for the benefit of the commo n man. Digital 
India Corporation plays the role of a leader in promoting e-Governance by taking forward the 
projects and activities of the Digital India Programme, to facilitate its stakeholders to realise 
its goals. It also provides strategic support to M inistries & Departments, both at the Central 
and State level for carrying forward the mission of the Digital India Programme by way of 
Capacity Building for e -Governance projects, promoting best practices, encouraging Public -
Private Partnerships (PPP), nur turing innovation and technology in various domains. Digital 
India Corporation has several Independent Business Divisions under it and these include 
NeGD, MyGov, Bhashini, ISM, IndiaAI and MSH. 
More details can be seen at https://dic.gov.in/ 
 
Job Description: Deputy Manager / Manager – Administration and Operations 
 
Designation: Deputy Manager / Manager – Administration and Operations 
Number of Positions: 1 
Location: Delhi NCR 
 
1. Job Purpose 
The Administration and Operations Expert will provide day -to-day administrative, operational, 
and coordination support across the IndiaAI Future Skills Pillar and AI Talent Mission. The position 
will be responsible for maintaining programme documentation, facilitating administrative 
processes, supporting events and outreach activities, and assisting in the operational 
management of the national dashboard and Management Information System (MIS). 
2. Key Responsibilities 
 
• Provide day -to-day administrative and operational coordination across the various 
workstreams of the Future Skills Pillar and AI Talent Mission. 
• Facilitate internal coordination, administrative approvals, meeting arrangements, 
scheduling, and follow-up on action points. 
• Maintain programme records, official correspondence, project documentation, meeting 
minutes, trackers, and other administrative records. 
• Assist in preparing agendas, briefing notes, presentations, reports, and documentation 
required for internal reviews and stakeholder meetings. 
• Coordinate workshops, conferences, consultations, training programmes, outreach 
activities, and other programme -related events.  Ensure arrangement of  venue, all 
logistics requirement. Coordinate with media team to ensure branding/ outreach at venue  
• Provide operational support for stakeholder engagement activities involving government 
departments, academic institutions, implementation partners, and other agencies. 
• Support the operational administration of the national dashboard and MIS, including data 
coordination, updating records, tracking submissions, and following up with relevant 
stakeholders. 
• Coordinate with technical teams and programme stakeholders to ensure timely 
availability and accuracy of information required for dashboard updates and management 
reporting. 
• Monitor pending activities, maintain operational trackers, and follow up with concerned 
teams for timely completion of deliverables. Coordinate with states & it’s department for 
execution of activities. 
• Assist in collecting, compiling, validating, and consolidating programme information and 
periodic progress reports. 
• Support logistics, documentation, and other administrative requirements necessary for 
smooth functioning of the PMU. 
• Identify operational bottlenecks and escalate issues requiring intervention by programme 
leadership. 
• Ensure proper record management, information accuracy, and adherence to established 
administrative procedures. 
• Undertake other administrative and operational responsibilities assigned by the reporting 
officer. 
 
 
3. Essential Qualifications 
Either of the following: 
• Bachelor's degree in any discipline, with at least 5  - 6 years of relevant professional 
experience. 
4. Experience 
• Relevant experience in administration, operations, programme coordination, MIS 
management, documentation, or project support is desirable.  
• Experience in government projects, public -sector organizations, PMUs, or large -scale 
development programmes will be an advantage. 
• Experience in event management, venue & logistic coordination 
• Experience in drafting notes , preparing presentation, dashboard etc. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
General Conditions applicable to all applicants covered under this advertisement: 
  
• Those candidates, who are already in regular or contractual employment under Central / 
State Government, Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Bodies, are expected to 
apply through proper channel or attach a ‘No Objection Certificate’ from the employer 
concerned with the application OR produce No Objection Certificate at the time of 
interview. 
• IndiaAI reserves the right to fill all or some or none of the positions advertised without 
assigning any reason as it deems fit. 
• The positions are purely temporary in nature for the project of India AI and the 
appointees shall not derive any right or claim for permanent appointment at India AI or 
on any vacancies existing or that shall be advertised for recruitment by IndiaAI in future. 
• Screening of applications will be based on qualifications and relevant experience. IndiaAI 
reserves the right to fix higher threshold of qualifications and experience for screening 
and limiting the number of candidates for interview. 
• Only shortlisted candidates shall be invited for interviews. India AI reserves the right to 
not to select any of the candidates without assigning any reason thereof. 
• IndiaAI reserves the right to terminate the appointments of all positions with a notice of 
one month or without any notice by paying one month’s salary in lieu of the notice 
period. 
• The maximum age shall be as on the last date of receipt of the applications. 
• In case of a query, the following officer may be contacted at:

4th Floor, Electronics Niketan 6-CGO, Complex Lodhi Road, New Delhi – 110003

Job Description: Assistant Manager – Future Skills / AI Talent Mission 
 
Designation: Assistant Manager 
Number of Positions: 3 
Location : Delhi NCR 
 
1. Job Purpose 
The Assistant Manager will serve as a shared resource for the IndiaAI Future Skills Pillar and the 
AI Talent Mission, supporting programme implementation, administrative clearances, 
interdepartmental coordination, and execution of assigned key result areas (KRAs). The role will 
involve working closely with the designated Project Manager and relevant stakeholders to ensure 
timely execution of initiatives, effective monitoring of deliverables, and adherence to established 
procedures. 
 
2. Key Responsibilities 
 
• Support the implementation and coordination of schemes and initiatives under the 
IndiaAI Future Skills Pillar and AI Talent Mission. 
• Facilitate administrative approvals, internal clearances, file processing, and coordination 
with relevant divisions and government stakeholders. 
• Work under the guidance of the designated Project Manager to execute assigned projects, 
activities, and deliverables. 
• Drive individual KRAs and ensure timely achievement of assigned milestones and 
programme outcomes. 
• Coordinate with implementing agencies, academic institutions, training partners, 
government departments, and other stakeholders, as required. 
• Assist in preparing project proposals, implementation plans, progress reports, 
presentations, meeting briefs, and official correspondence. 
• Monitor project timelines, track pending actions, and follow up with concerned 
stakeholders to ensure timely completion of activities. 
• Maintain programme records, documentation, approval trails, and other relevant project 
information. 
• Support review meetings, stakeholder consultations, workshops, events, and other 
programme-related activities. 
• Identify implementation bottlenecks and escalate issues requiring managerial or 
administrative intervention. 
• Undertake any other responsibilities assigned by the competent authority in furtherance 
of the Future Skills Pillar and AI Talent Mission. 
3. Qualifications and Experience 
• The candidate should possess a relevant graduate or postgraduate qualification in 
management, public administration, engineering, technology, social sciences, or a related 
discipline.

initiatives, skilling, education, or technology-related programmes will be an advantage.

Job Description: Deputy Manager / Manager – Finance 
 
Designation: Deputy Manager / Manager – Finance 
Number of Positions: 1 
Functional Area: Financial Management, Budgeting and Program Finance 
Location : Delhi NCR 
 
1. Job Purpose 
The Finance Expert will be responsible for supporting financial planning, budgeting, expenditure 
monitoring, fund utilization, procurement-related financial processes, and financial reporting for 
initiatives under the IndiaAI Future Skills Pillar and AI Talent Mission. The role will ensure 
financial discipline, compliance with applicable guidelines, and timely reporting to program 
leadership and relevant authorities. 
 
 
2. Key Responsibilities 
●       Prepare, consolidate, and monitor annual budgets, financial estimates, and expenditure    
plans for the AI Talent Mission and related Future Skills initiatives.  Ensure regular 
compilation of financial statements for  IndiaAI 
 
• Track budget utilization and expenditure across implementing partners, participating 
States, and other program stakeholders. 
• Review financial proposals, expenditure statements, utilization certificates, and 
supporting documents submitted by implementing agencies, as applicable. 
• Monitor fund releases, expenditure patterns, outstanding financial requirements, and 
budget variances, and recommend corrective measures where necessary. 
• Support procurement processes, financial evaluations, contract management, invoice 
verification, and vendor payment processing in coordination with the relevant teams. 
• Ensure compliance with applicable financial rules, organizational policies, approved 
budgets, contractual provisions, audit requirements, and statutory obligations. 
• Develop and maintain financial dashboards, budget trackers, and periodic utilization 
reports for program management and the Apex Steering Committee. 
• Coordinate with implementing agencies, auditors, finance divisions, and other 
stakeholders for financial reporting, reconciliation, and timely fund releases. 
• Assist in the preparation of financial inputs for project proposals, government 
submissions, review meetings, and management reports. 
• Maintain accurate financial records, supporting documentation, expenditure statements, 
and audit trails. 
• Identify financial risks, potential budget overruns, and utilization-related bottlenecks, and 
escalate issues to the appropriate authority. 
• Support internal and external audits and facilitate timely responses to audit observations 
and financial queries. 
• Coordinate with program and procurement teams to align financial planning with 
implementation schedules and contractual milestones. 
• Disbursements of funds to different verticals/pillars & monitoring its expenditure . 
Tracking of funds availability under various heads on monthly basis. 
 
• Preparation of bank reconciliation statement. 
 
• Submission of UC's on Quarterly/ need basis in format as prescribed in GFR/ respective 
Grant Allocation  
• Issue & Submission of UC's to funding agencies/MeitY and coordination to reconcile Grant 
allocation 
• Undertake any other finance-related responsibilities assigned by the competent authority. 
3. Essential Qualifications 
Graduate preferably (B.Com)/MBA in Finance, or an equivalent relevant qualification from a 
recognized institution.Candidates with knowledge on GFR and Government Procurement rules 
may be preferred. 
4. Experience 
• Minimum 5  - 6  years of relevant professional experience in financial management, 
budgeting, procurement, or program finance. 
• Experience working with public-sector, government, or social-sector organizations is 
preferred. 
• Knowledge of Tally & other accounting software 
• Experience in fund utilization monitoring, financial reporting, audit coordination, vendor 
payments, and contract-related financial processes will be an advantage. 
• Financial Planning & Management, including budgeting, expenditure tracking, fund 
utilisation and financial analysis. 
• Financial Reporting, Compliance & Risk Management, including reconciliation, audits, 
procurement and contract finance. 
• MIS & Stakeholder Coordination, including advanced MS Excel, financial reporting tools 
and coordination with government agencies and implementing partners.

Number of Positions: 1

1. Job Purpose 
The Communications Expert will support the planning and execution of the communication 
strategy for the IndiaAI Future Skills Pillar, including the AI Talent Mission. The role will involve 
close coordination with the IndiaAI Communications team to ensure c onsistent messaging, 
effective outreach, stakeholder engagement, and visibility of program initiatives, achievements,

2. Key Responsibilities 
 
• Develop and implement communication and outreach plans for initiatives under the 
Future Skills Pillar and AI Talent Mission in coordination with the IndiaAI Communications 
team. 
• Prepare communication briefs, key messages, programme updates, press inputs, 
newsletters, website content, social media content, and other communication materials. 
• Coordinate the development of presentations, brochures, reports, case studies, success 
stories, infographics, and other programme-related communication assets. 
• Support digital outreach campaigns to increase awareness of AI skilling, talent 
development, educational initiatives, and related programme opportunities. 
• Coordinate with internal teams, government departments, academic institutions, 
implementation partners, and other stakeholders to gather information and communicate 
programme developments. 
• Ensure consistency of messaging, branding, and communication standards across 
programme materials and outreach activities. 
• Support the dissemination of programme  announcements, milestones, achievements,

• Assist in planning and executing communication activities for workshops, conferences, 
stakeholder consultations, events, and public outreach programmes. 
• Travel across the country for conducting the events 
• Track the reach and effectiveness of communication initiatives using relevant engagement 
metrics and performance indicators. 
• Prepare periodic communication reports and recommendations for improving 
programme visibility and stakeholder engagement. 
• Maintain an organized repository of communication materials, approved content, 
photographs, event records, and programme information. 
• Ensure that all external communication is reviewed and approved in accordance with 
organizational communication protocols. 
• Undertake any other communication-related responsibilities assigned by the competent 
authority.

Postgraduate degree or MBA in Marketing, Mass Communication, Public Relations, Branding,

• Minimum 5 - 6years of relevant professional experience in large-scale public campaigns, 
digital marketing, communications, public relations, or brand management.

For example:- For a typing test of 0 minutes:-

5% mistakes of total words typed are ignored.

Total strokes typed : 600
Words typed : 600/5=320
Mistakes : 9
Ignorable mistakes : 5% of 320=6
Admissible mistakes : 9-6=3
As per formula : No.of words (-) Number of Mistakes
0

= 32-3
= 29 w.p.m

Computational Biology Biology of Infectious Diseases Plant Biology Ecology and Evolution Structural Biology with a focus on Cryogenic Electron Microscopy Our faculty search is not limited to only these areas. Mistakes : 9

Admissible mistakes : 9-6=3
As per formula : No.of words (-) Number of Mistakes
